title: The Witch and the Love Potion of Unrequited Love
overview: The Witch of the Lake, Rose, falls for a knight, who later visits her seeking a love potion.

title: The Good Witch of the Lake
overview: Rose finds herself being conscious of her looks while Harij begins to wonder about her disheveled lifestyle.

title: The Black Tea Scented Witch's Song
overview: With every visit, Harij helps Rose realize things she's overlooked before. Even of a certain song she sings.

title: A Knight's Duty Even Unknown to the Witch
overview: Harij continues to feel pressured to accomplish his mission, though something inside himself begins to change.

title: To Be a Witch
overview: As time passes, Rose begins to realize the impact Harij is having on her life. However, to live as a witch...

title: The Witch and the Promised Love Potion
overview: With the potion complete, Rose explains to Harij how to use it, when he makes a shocking request to test it.

title: The One to Cast a Spell on the Princess Is a Witch
overview: With only one month before her wedding, Billaura took Harij's word to heart and decided to make a bold move.
